assertions.claim: A successful introductory passage on a settled topic reads Stock across every stratum against a discipline-literate substrate.
Seven Stock rows give RI exactly 1.0: the weighted sum equals the denominator.
ND is exactly zero: a textbook passage should contain no new claims.
SCR runs to 20-30 for pedagogical elaboration and is correct there. The interpretation bands for expository prose apply, not the argumentative ones.
Musica reads Stock, not null: the passage has prosody in the sense any text does, and its prosody sits at the UID-smooth baseline for its genre.
Astronomia reads Stock: a textbook reader could predict what comes next at every point. This is the global-UID analog of Musica-Stock.
